proposals.title: Adopt an Independent Board Chair Policy
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring separation of Chairman and CEO roles, with the Chairman preferably an Independent Director.
proposals.evidence: the Board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this shareholder proposal

proposals.title: Publish a Congruency Report on Political, Lobbying, Electioneering Expenditures
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annual report analyzing congruency of political, lobbying and electioneering expenditures with publicly stated company values, including on women's reproductive health.
proposals.evidence: the Board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this shareholder proposal

proposals.title: Amend Director Resignation Processes
proposals.proponent: New York City Carpenters Pension Fund
proposals.topic_summary: Requests amending the director resignation bylaw so the Board must accept tendered resignations absent a compelling reason, with automatic resignation for re-failed holdover directors.
proposals.evidence: the Board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this shareholder proposal

proposals.title: Publish a Report on Corporate Contributions
proposals.proponent: National Center for Public Policy Research
proposals.topic_summary: Requests Pfizer list recipients of corporate contributions of $5,000 or more to third-party public policy or nonprofit organizations on its website, with amounts and limitations.
proposals.evidence: the Board unanimously recommends that you vote "AGAINST" this shareholder proposal
